summary: Charlottesville, Virginia resident, board-certified anesthesiologist, retired neurosurgical anesthesiologist with 38 years of experience, former research scientist, author and blogger, grew up in Milwaukee, lived in Los Angeles and Tokyo, strong interest in technology and medical research, enjoys reading and sharing knowledge, has a left-handed preference, family includes a daughter and grandson, identifies as a "TechnoDolt," frequent contributor to Hacker News, engages in discussions about mental health and psychiatric medications, has a history of major depression and suicide attempt, advocates for mental health awareness and open discussions about personal experiences.
